description: This file defines the backend logic for the Login page in the Identity area of a web application. It manages user login authentication, including handling external login schemes, model binding for login data, session cleanup, and basket transfer post-login.

classes.name: LoginModel
classes.description: PageModel class for handling user login, including external login integration, user credential validation, and basket transfer upon successful login.

classes.name: InputModel
classes.description: Data transfer object for capturing user input during login, including email, password, and remember me options.

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Handles GET requests to initialize the login page, including signing out external cookies and fetching external login schemes.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests for login submission, validating credentials, managing different login outcomes, and transferring baskets.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketToUserAsync
methods.description: Transfers an anonymous shopping basket to the authenticated user if a basket cookie is present.
